metadata.Name: Russian Jeopardy! Data Set
metadata.Description: The Russian Jeopardy! Data Set is a collection of 29,375 quiz-like questions from the Russian quiz database ChGK, including questions from the Russian analogue of Jeopardy! called 'Own Game'. The dataset is intended for question-answering systems and includes questions that test players' logic and erudition.
metadata.Paper Title: Russian Jeopardy! Data Set for Question-Answering Systems
metadata.Venue Title: Proceedings of the 58th Annual Meeting of the Association for Computational Linguistics
metadata.Abstract: Question answering (QA) is one of the most common NLP tasks that relates to named entity recognition, fact extraction, semantic search and some other fields. In industry, it is much valued in chat-bots and corporate information systems. It is also a challenging task that attracted the attention of a very general audience at the quiz show Jeopardy! In this article we describe a Jeopardy!-like Russian QA dataset collected from the official Russian quiz database Chgk che-ge-‘ka:. The data set includes 379,284 quiz-like questions with 29,375 from the Russian analogue of Jeopardy! – 'Own Game'. We observe its linguistic features and the related QA-task. We conclude about perspectives of a QA challenge based on the collected dataset.
